title: Napoleon_vs_Wellington_Short_s2_iron_duke
commoners_en: 1815 soldiers of both armies, French grenadiers in tall bearskin hats and blue coats and British redcoat infantry in black shakos, mixed with Belgian farm villagers
venue_en: the walled courtyard of Hougoumont farm at Waterloo in 1815 at dusk turned into an underground rap battle arena, rough stone farm walls, drifting cannon smoke, flaming torches; on the left side French tricolour banners and golden imperial eagle standards with blue-and-gold drums, on the right side British Union flags and scarlet regimental colours with stacked muskets, a raised DJ booth built on a bronze field cannon and wooden powder barrels in the center background
light_en: dramatic low-key dusk lighting, warm orange torchlight against a cold blue-white spotlight beam cutting through drifting cannon smoke, strong backlit haze
arena_sound_en: a torchlit stone farm courtyard packed with roaring soldiers
crowd_motion_en: the packed crowd moves with the music the whole time, heads nodding and fists pumping on every beat, bodies bouncing and swaying, some soldiers jumping and waving their hats
suno_style: English battle rap, classic old school boom bap, 95 BPM, dark cinematic epic, hard punchy drums, military snare rolls, vinyl scratches, orchestral brass stabs, timpani hits, deep sub bass, live crowd hype, two contrasting male rappers, clear English diction, very short intro, short ending, two-round battle, short loud crowd reactions between verses

a.look: 1815 French emperor, black felt bicorne hat worn sideways, open grey wool greatcoat over a dark green colonel's uniform coat with red collar and gold buttons, white waistcoat, silver Legion of Honour star on his chest, short dark-brown hair combed forward, clean-shaven, slightly stout, holding a gleaming golden laurel wreath in his left hand
a.voice: fiery imperious male rapper, intense commanding tenor voice, fast aggressive staccato flow
a.prop_desc: a simple open circlet of gleaming golden laurel leaves like a Roman emperor's victory wreath, held in the hand, not worn; no jewels, no gems, no spikes, never a royal crown
a.look_cn: 侧戴黑色双角帽、敞开的灰色呢大衣、深绿色上校军服配红领、胸前荣誉军团勋章，左手托着金色月桂花环
a.listen_cn: 背手冷笑、一只手插进马甲、不耐烦地扬起下巴

b.look: 1815 British field marshal, tall and lean, prominent hooked aquiline nose, short curly greying brown hair with long sideburns, clean-shaven, scarlet British field marshal's coat with gold epaulettes and gold-embroidered collar, white cravat, black bicorne hat worn front-to-back, holding an extended brass spyglass telescope in his left hand
b.voice: cold aristocratic British male rapper, dry deep baritone voice, measured cutting boom-bap flow
b.prop_desc: a long extended brass naval spyglass telescope with leather grip
b.look_cn: 高瘦、鹰钩鼻、猩红色英国元帅军服配金色肩章、白领巾、前后向戴的黑色双角帽，左手握黄铜单筒望远镜
b.listen_cn: 面无表情、挑眉、用望远镜轻敲掌心

a: Seventeen sixty-nine, the world got a brand-new king
I crowned myself at Notre-Dame, the Pope just blessed the thing
Three emperors at Austerlitz — two of them took flight
My Code still writes the law in half the world tonight
Your troops say "Old Nosey" — I say "sepoy general"
Beating rajahs doesn't make you my equal
Sixty battles fought — I had all Europe on my plate
You? You're just a breakfast, and an Emperor won't wait
Took me down? You prayed for night or the Prussians to arrive
They hit my flank at half past four — that's how you survived
"Nearest-run thing you ever saw" — your own words, Duke
Your "scum of the earth" soldiers won you that fluke
Your own people smashed your windows when you blocked reform
Iron shutters — that's how the "Iron Duke" was born
Your legacy's a rubber boot for walking through the mud
Mine's a whole era, written in my Code and blood
b: Breakfast? Then why'd you wait till noon to fire a gun?
Waiting on the mud to dry — by sunset, you were done
Six hundred thousand marched to Moscow, proud and fed
Count the men who made it home — the winter kept the dead
You called Spain your "ulcer" — guess who made it bleed?
Your marshals came in one by one, and one by one they'd flee
"Sepoy general"? Fine — this sepoy took you down
One day at Waterloo — so long, your self-made crown
Elba couldn't hold you, so we found a smaller rock
Saint Helena, South Atlantic — five years watching the clock
We took your horse, Marengo — his bones are on display
In a London museum — people stare at him all day
Canova carved you naked, marble, eleven feet tall
Now you stand in my stairwell with a fig leaf in my hall
Two hundred years later, the world still has a word for you
Lose it all, and people say you met your Waterloo

a: 史实：拿破仑生于 1769 年；巧合的是威灵顿也生于同一年。
史实：1804 年巴黎圣母院加冕礼上，拿破仑拿起皇冠自己戴上，教皇庇护七世只做了祝福。
史实：1805 年奥斯特利茨战役（「三皇会战」）击败俄奥联军。
史实：1804 年《拿破仑法典》影响了欧洲和拉美许多国家的民法（「半个世界」是夸张）。
史实：威灵顿的士兵叫他「老鼻子」；据记载拿破仑轻蔑地称他为「印度兵将军」。
史实：威灵顿早年在印度击败过迈索尔和马拉塔的军队。
常见说法：拿破仑一生指挥过约 60 场战斗，一度控制欧洲大部分地区。
据记载：滑铁卢当天早上，拿破仑对部下说打败威灵顿「不过是吃顿早饭的事」。
据传：威灵顿在战斗中说「我希望天快黑，或者普鲁士人快来」。
史实：下午约 4 点半，普鲁士军开始进攻法军右翼的普朗斯努瓦。
史实：威灵顿事后说滑铁卢是「你这辈子见过的最险的一仗」。
史实：1813 年威灵顿在信中称自己的士兵是「地球上的渣滓」。
史实：1831 年议会改革风潮中，反对改革的威灵顿的宅邸窗户被民众砸碎。
一说：「铁公爵」的绰号与他随后装上的铁百叶窗有关（绰号来源说法不一）。
史实：威灵顿让鞋匠改制的靴子后来演变成雨靴，英国人至今叫它「wellies」。
史实：那个时代被称为「拿破仑时代」。
b: 史实：前夜大雨导致地面泥泞，拿破仑推迟到约上午 11 点半才开战。
史实：当晚法军全线溃败。
史实：1812 年约 60 万大军进攻俄国（各家估算不一）。
史实：撤退途中的严冬、饥饿和追击让大军团损失了绝大部分兵力。
史实：拿破仑晚年称西班牙战争是拖垮他的「西班牙溃疡」。
史实：半岛战争中，威灵顿先后击败马塞纳、马尔蒙、苏尔特等多位法军元帅。
史实：1815 年 6 月 18 日滑铁卢战败后，拿破仑第二次退位。
史实：1814 年拿破仑被流放厄尔巴岛，1815 年逃回法国（百日王朝）。
史实：滑铁卢后被流放到南大西洋的圣赫勒拿岛，1821 年死在岛上。
史实：拿破仑的坐骑马伦哥在滑铁卢被英军俘获，带回英国。
史实：马伦哥的骨架现藏于伦敦国家陆军博物馆。
史实：卡诺瓦雕刻的拿破仑裸体像高约 3.45 米（约 11 英尺），拿破仑本人不喜欢它。
史实：1816 年英国政府买下这尊像送给威灵顿，至今立在他伦敦宅邸的楼梯间。
英语里「meet one's Waterloo」意思是遭遇惨败。
